Interface LibrarySystem

  • public interface LibrarySystem
    An abstract data type representing a library management system for books, users, and library branches. The interface provides methods for borrowing, returning, reserving books, and more.

    • Method Detail

      • borrowBook

        void borrowBook​(User user,
                Book book,
                Library library,
                java.time.LocalDate dueDate)
        Attempts to borrow a book for a user from a specific library. The book must be available (not already borrowed or reserved), and the user must be eligible to borrow (i.e., has no overdue books and is within the borrowing limit).
        Parameters:
        user - the user attempting to borrow the book
        book - the book to be borrowed
        library - the library where the book is located
        dueDate - the expected due date for returning the book
        Throws:
        UnregisteredEntityException - if the user, book, or library is not known to the system
        InvalidDueDateException - if the provided due date is in the past
        BookUnavailableException - if the book is already borrowed or reserved
        UserNotEligibleException - if the user has overdue books or has reached the borrowing limit
        java.lang.NullPointerException - if any parameter is null
